newsitem.title: UK: BTR extends gains on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: BTR extends gains on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc were the biggest gainers in the FTSE 100 index on Wednesday, as bargain-hunting after recent steep losses continued and talk circulated of possible break-up valuations, dealers said.

The stock closed 9-1/2p or 4.9 percent higher at 203-1/2 in heavy turnover of 14.5 million shares, with dealers also noting heavy trade on the Tradepoint share trading network, which rivals the London Stock Exchange.
Tradepoint said it had traded 3.3 million shares in BTR, including a block of one million shares.

Still reacting to a profit warning earlier this year, BTR shares tumbled to a low around 180p last week, the lowest in more than five years. Yet they have since rebounded against the trend of the UK equity market overall.
